$comment: MCP server registration. Runs bin/claude-workspaces-mcp.sh under /bin/sh, which picks the relay: the compiled one where it can build it, else mcp/relay.js under a node or bun binary it resolves itself. The full stdio child (mcp/index.js) is no longer shipped; its last release is the git tag mcp-full-child-rollback. It does NOT say `command: node`: node is often installed by nvm, whose PATH setup lives in ~/.zshrc, so `node` resolves in an interactive shell and nowhere else — sessions launched by launchd, a GUI app, or cron died with a bare ENOENT and no workspace tools. /bin/sh is the one interpreter always present. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is Claude Code's substitution for the install path, so nothing here is CWD-dependent. mcp/relay.js is regenerated by `bun run build:mcp`. Port is auto-discovered from ~/.claude/claude-workspaces/server.json. `scripts/migrate-rename.ts` moves that directory on the box at rollout; serve.ts writes only the new path, and the MCP child reads the new path first and the old one after it, because nothing orders the server restart against each session respawn.
